car.name: Butterbur 1991
car.description: Johnny Herbert / Volker Weidler / Bertrand Gachot, 1991 Le Mans-winning Mazda 787B #55 inspiration. R26B four-rotor, rear drive, five-speed manual. Original silver/indigo art. Rotary-specific sound and dynamics are approximated; event setup estimates labeled.

catalogProvenance.referenceVehicle: Johnny Herbert / Volker Weidler / Bertrand Gachot, 1991 Le Mans overall-winning Mazda 787B #55, chassis 787B-002. Not older 787 or 767B, road RX-7 or later demonstration tune.

sources.access: Manufacturer chassis/event page: #55/787B-002, 362 laps; full dimensions and tracks; over839kg; Mazda-Porsche five-speed; 654cc x4 and FISA4708.8cc equivalent;18in staggered tires.
